mapper.sql: select id, title, topic_content, remark, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from tb_topic_info
mapper.select:
select t.*,GROUP_CONCAT(label_id) labels from (select info.id,info.title,info.topic_content,info.status,info.del_flag, info.create_time,info.create_by,max(reply.create_time) latestReplyDate, count(reply.id) replyNum,IFNULL(visit.visitNum,0) visitNum from tb_topic_info info left join tb_topic_reply reply on info.id = reply.topic_id left join (select count(id) visitNum,topic_id from tb_topic_visit GROUP BY topic_id) visit on info.id = visit.topic_id GROUP BY info.id) t left join tb_topic_label label on t.id = label.topic_id
left join tb_user_follow follow on follow.topic_id = t.id where follow.user_id = #{username} and t.status = '2' and t.del_flag='0'
left join tb_topic_reply tr on tr.topic_id = t.id where tr.replyer_id = #{username} and t.status = '2' and t.del_flag='0'
where t.create_by = #{username}
left join tb_topic_reply_praise praise on praise.topic_id = t.id where praise.create_by = #{username} and t.status = '2' and t.del_flag='0'
where t.status = '2' and t.del_flag='0'
GROUP BY t.id
and (t.title like concat('%',#{name},'%') or t.topic_content like concat('%',#{name},'%'))
and labels like concat('%',#{labelId},'%')
order by t.latestReplyDate t.replyNum t.create_time t.visitNum desc
SELECT id,title,topic_content FROM tb_topic_info where status = 2 and del_flag = '0' and (title like concat('%',#{name},'%') or topic_content like concat('%',#{name},'%'))

mapper.delete: update tb_topic_info set del_flag = '2' where id = #{id}
